components.description: Simple / Avanzado switch: hairline track off, ivory track on; amber ring only on focus.
components.css: .ds-mode { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 9pt; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #8c8a86; } .ds-mode .on { color: #f4ede0; font-weight: 700; } .ds-switch { appearance: none; width: 44px; height: 24px; border-radius: 12px; background: #3a3a42; position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1); margin: 0; } .ds-switch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f4ede0; transition: left 160ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1), background 160ms; } .ds-switch:checked { background: #f4ede0; } .ds-switch:checked::after { left: 23px; background: #131315; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #e9a23b; outline-offset: -1px; }

narrative.overview:
The app is a radio left on at night. Graphite chrome, ivory type, and a single amber light that marks only what is playing now: here, what is downloading. Everything else is quiet. Panels are flat graphite slabs separated by hairlines rather than shadows; labels are set like the printing on a tuner faceplate, narrow, uppercase and tracked; the one moving part is the dial needle sliding across a scale of fine ticks.

Colour has two homes and only two: the cover art of whatever was pasted, shown large and untinted, and the amber light. Interaction uses ivory, not amber: the primary button is an ivory slab, focus is an ivory outline, the selected nav item is ivory text with an ivory underline. That keeps amber legible as a status signal instead of a brand tint. The system refuses the dark developer tool with a neon accent and a sidebar of forms; options live in four bordered tiles on one panel, and advanced controls fold away behind "Más opciones".

Dark is the primary rendition. A light rendition of the same world (warm paper ground, ink type, deeper amber) is used when Windows is in light mode or the user picks "Claro"; it keeps every rule, only the values change.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, graphite panels, hairline borders; no shadows anywhere.
Ivory is the interaction colour; amber is a status light, never a decoration.
Archivo for reading, Archivo Narrow uppercase tracked for labels, bands and numerals.
Covers shown large, untinted, with gently rounded corners.
Custom-painted radio pieces: the band selector, the tick dial with amber needle, the toggle switch.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Amber means "on air now". It appears only on something that is actively downloading or currently selected as the band or tool. If nothing is playing, the screen has no amber except the wordmark's interpunct. Never use amber for a button, a link, a hover, or a heading.

rules.name: The Wordmark Exception
rules.body: The interpunct in DVDY·STUDIO is painted amber permanently: the needle's mark on the faceplate. It is the only standing amber in the app and is not a precedent for any other element.

rules.name: The Untinted Cover Rule
rules.body: Cover art is shown as is: no overlays, no duotone, no colour wash. It is the only full colour on screen.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: Every piece of text is 9pt, 10.5pt or 17pt. Hierarchy below the title comes from weight, colour (ivory vs ash) and the narrow uppercase label face, never from a new size.

rules.name: The Faceplate Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is only ever set in Archivo Narrow with tracking; Archivo itself is always sentence case.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from a tonal step plus a hairline. Never add a drop shadow, glow, or blur to a panel, menu, or button.

dos: Do keep amber for the thing that is downloading now, the selected band and the selected tool; check the screen with nothing downloading and confirm the only amber left is the wordmark's interpunct.
Do use ivory for every interactive emphasis: the primary button, focus outlines, checked states, active nav and tab underlines.
Do separate surfaces with a one-step tonal change and a 1px hairline.
Do set every label, band name, tab, table header and dial numeral in Archivo Narrow, uppercase, tracked about 1px.
Do show cover art large and untinted on graphite raised, rounded 8px (6px at thumbnail size).
Do give the light rendition the same structure and rules, swapping only the values.
donts: Don't use amber on buttons, links, hovers, headings or decorative accents.
Don't add drop shadows, glows or blurs.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or tint cover art.
Don't set Archivo (the reading face) in uppercase, or add a fourth text size.
Don't turn the options into a sidebar of form fields; essential options sit in the four tiles, the rest behind "Más opciones".
